findings.label: finish() Cancelled supersession untested
findings.detail: brn-ai/src/threads.rs:2474 treats a chat's earlier Cancelled Runs as superseded, which is the only path that retires a notice saved on an old Cancelled Run (the shape round 4 builds wrote). Before slice D, a_later_run_replaces_the_notice_of_a_run_the_settings_change_cancelled reached that arm; its Run is now Interrupted. No other test in brn-ai, brn-threads-app, brn or the desktop seeds a Cancelled Run with the notice and then runs finish(), so dropping '| RunState::Cancelled' there would leave the suite green. Found by reading; not mutation-tested.
findings.action: Add a leg that seeds the killed Run as Cancelled with the Interrupted notice, completes Continue, and expects [Review(op)].

findings.label: Continue model context missing from the consumer table
findings.detail: begin() in brn-ai/src/threads.rs:1989 sends {"run","progress","state": format!("{:?}", run.state)} to the model for prior Runs with progress, so a settings-stopped Run now reads "Interrupted" there. Nothing branches on the value and threads_guides.rs does not mention either state, but slice D's consumer table omits it.
findings.action: Add the row to slice D's consumer table in round5/verification.md.

findings.label: "Cancels" wording for settings stops
findings.detail: crates/brn-threads-core/README.md (147, 166) and crates/brn-threads-app/README.md (17) still say settings changes cancel active runs, and the test a_later_run_replaces_the_notice_of_a_run_the_settings_change_cancelled keeps its name. The proposed contract sentence covers threads-behavior.md only.
findings.action: List the README lines in slice D's integration items next to the proposed threads-behavior.md sentence; optionally rename the test.

findings.label: Desktop run-line claim
findings.detail: The new desktop assertion recomputes format!("{:?}", state) from latest_run instead of reading the drawn run-line text, so a change to how the line formats a state would leave it green. The commit says the run line 'reads Interrupted'.
findings.action: Reword the claim to 'the run line's latest Run is Interrupted', or assert the rendered text if the harness allows.
